name: Lakshmi Engineering and Warehousing Limited
about: Lakshmi Engineering and Warehousing Limited provides warehouse rental services in India and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Warehousing Rental Services and Engineering Services. It leases a warehouse for logistics companies at Hosur. The company also offers automatic weaving machines and circular knitting machines; VDI standard tool, boring bar, VDI non-standard, rectangular tool, and collect chuck holders; accessories and parts for weaving and circular knitting machines; and conveyor parts, such as rollers, shafts, and bearing blocks, etc. In addition, it exports its weaving and circular knitting machines to Europe, China, etc. The company was formerly known as Lakshmi Automatic Loom Works Limited and changed its name to Lakshmi Engineering and Warehousing Limited in October 2024. Lakshmi Engineering and Warehousing Limited was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Coimbatore, India.
